name: DeepFashion2: Clothing Detection, Pose Estimation, Segmentation and Retrieval Benchmark
description: DeepFashion2 is a large-scale clothing benchmark containing 491,895 high-resolution images across diverse consumer and commercial scenarios. It provides comprehensive annotations for 801,492 clothing items, each annotated with clothing category, bounding box, per-instance segmentation mask, fine-grained landmark coordinates with visibility flags, style classification, and cross-domain commercial-consumer retrieval pairs.
